messages:
maria_finops: FYI billing alert — discovered ~120k in GPU spend for last month in us-west1 that has no 'cost_center' label. This is blocking accurate chargebacks.
aj_enginfra: Thanks, looking. Is this from Dedicated pools or ephemeral clusters?
maria_finops: Most rows look like committed use discounts applied but project-level labels are empty. Export shows projects like rdx-experiments-3 and rdx-heavy-batch with null labels.cost_center.
samir_sre: I can run a quick BigQuery rollup if you point to the export dataset. Also wondering if autoscaler-created instances (k8s nodepools) lost labels during reprovisioning.
elaine_platform: We changed nodepool naming last quarter; some infra automation used to inject labels but we switched to tags. GCP export only surfaces labels, not tags, so that could explain mismatch.
maria_finops: Ugh, that's the kind of divergence we feared. Billing team needs a retroactive allocation for the month and a plan so this never repeats. CFO asked for corrected invoice numbers by Friday.
aj_enginfra: Ok. First step: identify unlabelled projects and map them to owners and logical products. I'll run this query now:
```sql
SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_invoice.gcp_billing_export_v1_012345`
WHERE cost != 0 AND project.labels.cost_center IS NULL
AND sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
samir_sre: I'll also look at cluster creation audit logs to see who/what created those nodepools. If nodepool names contain a product slug we can backfill labels heuristically.
elaine_platform: I have a small script for label backfill we used in 2024. It matches instance names and job labels and writes to a reconciliation table. Example snippet:
```bash
# backfill labels from instance metadata
python tools/label_backfill.py --source bigquery --dataset billing_recon --dry-run
```
maria_finops: Great. Two asks: 1) run the rollup and produce a mapping (project -> inferred cost_center -> cost) 2) propose a retro allocation rule (percent split if ambiguous). Recommend we avoid assigning < $500 items individually; group them under "platform_misc".
aj_enginfra: Will do. Preliminary thought: for projects clearly tied to research experiments (name contains "exp" or owner tag is @elaine_platform) we allocate to R&D. For Dedicated pool SKUs with committed discounts we need to allocate the committed cost proportionally to running teams vs platform baseline; I'll propose a 70/30 split (users/platform) unless owners object.
samir_sre: FYI audit logs show a burst of cluster creations from a CI job in project rdx-experiments-3 on 2026-01-11 — looks like a long-running experiment that left GPUs attached for 9 days. Could be the bulk of the spend.
maria_finops: If that's the case we should bill that project/team directly. Elaine, can you confirm ownership of rdx-experiments-3?
elaine_platform: Confirmed — owner is @aj_enginfra for the project but the experiment belongs to @samir_sre's SRE sandbox. I'll add that mapping to the reconciliation table.
billing-bot: Invoice import complete: invoice_id=INV-2026-01-789, total_gpu_cost=121034.56, unlabeled=118902.15
maria_finops: Wow. OK action items: aj -> run query + push CSV to #eng-infra-recon by EOD (1767518600). samir -> correlate audit logs and push candidate mappings. elaine -> run label_backfill dry-run and share results. Finance will draft a provisional allocation with 3 buckets: direct owner, platform allocation (for shared committed baseline), and misc.
aj_enginfra: One more note: long-term fix is to standardize on project labels (cost_center, product, owner_email) enforced via org policy and a pre-commit GCP infra CI check. I'll open a small RFC for that.
maria_finops: Please include a retro process: when labels are backfilled we should re-run GCP billing export attribution and issue corrected charge statements. CFO expects a one-line summary of adjustments.
samir_sre: I'll also add an alert in infra-monitoring to detect when GPU instances exist without a cost_center label for >12h.
elaine_platform: I can scope the RFC and a tiny webhook that auto-tags nodepool creations from common infra jobs.
maria_finops: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll escalate to ops leadership.
aj_enginfra: Running query now, will paste results when ready.
